column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other in English; Arabic has six — zero, one, two, few (3-10),
# many (11-99), other — separated by '|' (plural_arabic in lang.rs).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels in Modern Standard
# Arabic, using the terms Arabic-speaking users of creative software know (Microsoft style:
# تثبيت، تحديث، تنزيل، إعدادات، ملاحظات الإصدار…). Western digits.
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, VectorCraft, PdfCraft, EffectCraft,
# Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Esc).
# Arabic reads right to left; the shell keeps egui's left-to-right run order until a bidi
# pass lands, so labels still lay out left to right for now.
# Entries are in logical (typing) order; Latin runs and digits inside a label draw left to right.
# Shown with the system's Arabic font (Segoe UI, Geeza Pro, Noto Sans Arabic…): see cjk_font.rs;
# where the system has none, the interface stays in English.
